evidence.claim: The current 23 owned mocks have an approved remediated snapshot; attributed historical banks remain outside paid detail.
Owned guided mocks are noindex/noarchive and anonymous users receive only the membership offer, not questions or feedback.
The sitemap contains the pedagogical public cluster but not the membership-gated owned-mock guided routes.
The facade fixes the 12k/49k/99k prices, exam-scoped monthly SKUs and deterministic upgrade quotes.
Monthly checkout recalculates the active-member quote server-side and persists the exact offer, scope, credit and amount.
Anonymous result access uses a signed, attempt-scoped capability with a documented 30-day lifetime.
The route requires a matching capability or authenticated owner, checks ICFES membership scope, and requires an approved persisted one-time entitlement before returning answers.
Versioned retention/minor policy, fail-closed attempt writes, a minimal subject-request queue, pseudonymized teacher payload, RLS and column-scoped grants are modeled locally.
Retention, request deadlines, legal basis and minor handling remain unset pending human approval; export/deletion handlers, purge job and Sandbox proof do not yet exist.
A deterministic, hash-bound local run passes 10/10 adversarial cases for state transitions, tampering, replay, reversals and every required upgrade path without network or credentials.
Focused tests prove that unapproved states grant nothing, tampered provider facts are rejected, reversals revoke access and released upgrade credit cannot be reused by a late approval.
The migrations remain unapplied and no real or Sandbox checkout has granted an entitlement.
The monthly ledger models SKUs, upgrades and idempotent payment evidence, but live provider reversal mapping and operational refund/chargeback proof are not present.
A versioned, evidence-bound ICFES pedagogical rubric defines weighted criteria, required output and QA stop conditions without claiming an official score.
The local pure harness fixes one credit, a conditional 24-hour target, pre-checkout reservation, capacity stop conditions, request idempotency, queue leases and 12/18/22-hour alerts.

The unapplied migration models a service-role-only calibrated roster, atomic reservation, one review per membership, payment consumption, queue leases and alerts; ICFES requests require an owned nonempty icfes_attempts row and the leased payload projects that real answer source without identity.
Server-only helpers enqueue an attempt-bound review and read its payload through the lease/reviewer-checked RPC; no browser route or worker currently invokes them.
The generic ICFES history write does not persist objective_answers, so it is not accepted as teacher evidence.
An ICFES teacher order is rejected unless it carries the exact ICFES addendum version; other exam contracts remain unchanged.
The global terms still promise feedback after every complete submission, conflicting with the one-credit ICFES product unless the specific addendum is presented and accepted.
Local tests cover rubric/addendum scope, capacity blocking, reservation replay, finite credit, lease recovery, alerts, service-role guards and the secure-attempt evidence link.

No calibrated roster, observed utilization/p95, applied migration, checkout addendum capture, attempt-claim route, worker or immutable question snapshot exists; local controls do not justify enabling the tier.
Production activation, migration, legal review and real-environment evidence remain explicitly pending.
